data.one_liner: Launch URLs in Custom Tabs or SFSafariViewController from Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a plugin to open web URLs or deep links in the native browser experience on Android, iOS, and web. It supports extensive customization of the browser UI and lightweight launch options.
use_when: You need a native browser view with Custom Tabs or SFSafariViewController for web links
You want to customize toolbar colors, sharing, and other UI elements
You need to launch deep links or URLs from a Flutter app
avoid_when: You only need a simple URL launch without custom UI
You are targeting only web and prefer url_launcher directly
strengths: Supports deep links and custom headers
weaknesses: Not suitable for simple URL launches
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, run flutter pub get, ensure Android Gradle Plugin 9.0.0+, Kotlin 2.2.10+, Xcode 15+ for iOS. No build_runner needed.
